name: 西游记2003-2
group_note: Archived as '西游记2003-2' but the live game identifies itself as 三界神话 (SanJie Myth) 「测试二区」 -- another member of the same 三界 codebase family as 059 sanjiechuanshuo and 060 sanjieshenhua (identical get_gender()/enter_world()/make_body() bodies confirmed via direct diff against sanjieshenhua), with a vestigial Xi You Ji-themed opening ASCII banner left over from an earlier rebrand. WASM pass fixed 4 bugs, the last two found only via targeted write()-instrumentation bisection since they failed completely silently (no error trace at all): (1) adm/simul_efun/message.lpc's message() simul_efun wrapper called efun::message() with a bare 3-arg exclude default of int 0 instead of an array, crashing on 'Bad argument 4 to EFUN message()' from multiple call sites (disasterd.lpc's announce() among them) -- classic AGENTS.md §7.61, fixed with 'exclude || ({})'. (2) adm/obj/master.lpc's log_error() unconditionally called CHANNEL_D->do_channel() for every compile warning including harmless ones, and since CHANNEL_D isn't preloaded yet during the very first files compiled at boot, that call-other recursively triggered a fresh compile mid-compile, crashing with 'Object cannot be loaded during compilation' and cascading into a wall of repeated trace dumps -- classic AGENTS.md §7.60, fixed by guarding with find_object(CHANNEL_D) first. (3) adm/daemons/channeld.lpc's do_channel() called environment(me)->query('no_chat') unguarded; log_error()'s CHANNEL_D broadcast (bug 2, before it was fixed) passes the master object itself as 'me', which has no environment, crashing on a 0 target -- fixed with 'environment(me) && environment(me)->query(...)'. (4) The deepest bug, found by bisecting get_gender()->make_body()->new(USER_OB) with write() instrumentation at each step: the driver's own load_object() security check (triggered internally by new() compiling the player-body class for the first time) calls master.lpc's valid_read() apply with the MASTER OBJECT ITSELF as the 'user' argument; master.lpc's valid_read() just forwarded straight to securityd.lpc's valid_read() with no special case for system-initiated loads, and geteuid(master_ob) resolves to a falsy euid there, so the path-permission logic denied the read (silently -- no error message anywhere, since the driver's 'Read access denied' just makes new() return 0, and make_body()'s own failure-path write() never fires because the write target, the not-yet-exec'd login object, produces a message that's easy to miss without direct instrumentation) -- every single new-player registration died silently at gender selection with zero visible symptoms beyond 什么？ echoing for all further input. Fixed by short-circuiting master.lpc's valid_read()/should be paired with a similar guard on valid_write() if that class of bug recurs: 'if (user == this_object()) return 1;' before delegating to SECURITY_D. Also fixed the standard §8.1 GBK-byte-range bug in both adm/daemons/chinesed.lpc's is_chinese() (byte-range/parity-based) and adm/daemons/logind.lpc's check_legal_name() (same parity assumption), rewritten to per-codepoint checks -- this is what caused '小浮侠' to fail Chinese-name validation before that fix. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (securityd.lpc genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot). Registration flow verified end-to-end across several WASM client sessions given a call_out(0)-driven post-registration gift-stat menu that races the test harness's idle-based send pacing (heavy first-time player-body compile burst, matching the session's established xhcii/xkyxciii/xsfyssjb WASM timing-race pattern, not a mudlib bug -- confirmed via a fully clean run reaching look/score with zero errors): GB/BIG5 select -> underage gate absent on this sibling -> new -> English id -> admin password + confirm -> regular password + confirm -> Chinese name -> email -> gender (m/f) -> stat-allocation menu (9 to accept defaults, y to confirm) -> enters world silently at /d/wiz/init -> live disaster-event channel broadcasts and autosave firing correctly (proving the message()/CHANNEL_D fixes hold under real gameplay) -> look/score both clean. LPC formatter run across all 12362 .lpc files (12194 written, 36 errors -- pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content bugs unrelated to formatting, 132 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits; the case-label-with-trailing-comment blind spot found several matching lines (ftpd.lpc/natured.lpc/esman.lpc/vi.lpc) but diff-review confirmed the formatter preserved every following statement correctly (no swallowed code) on this run.
